title: Spear to 16x!
description: I'll make the texture of the spear in hand 16x!
body: Behold, the default Minecraft spear texture, originally rendered at 32×32 resolution, has been carefully converted into a 16×16 version for hand-held use! This new texture preserves the spear’s iconic appearance while streamlining its visual detail, improving clarity and consistency. Every moment of gameplay now showcases a clean, precise, and faithful representation of the spear, making it perfectly suited for both screenshots and in-game use without altering its recognizable form.
